name: Sunflower Oil
info: Sunflower Oil is a refined vegetable lipid extracted from sunflower seeds and processed for oxidative stability. It supplies a high concentration of linoleic acid and natural vitamin E, delivering a dense, digestible energy source.
description: Sunflower Oil is a premium vegetable lipid extracted from sunflower seeds and refined for high oxidative stability. It features a rich polyunsaturated fatty acid profile - predominantly linoleic acid - alongside high natural vitamin E content. Highly digestible and metabolizable, it serves as an excellent calorie densifier in high-performance animal feeds and a clean-tasting carrier in food manufacturing.
application: High-performance livestock and poultry feeds; Energy densifier in aquafeed formulations; Carrier oil in food manufacturing
packing: Bulk: Tank Containers (22-23 MT), Flexi Tank (22-23 MT)

name: Canola/Rapeseed Oil
info: Canola/Rapeseed Oil is a refined vegetable lipid extracted from oilseed rape, notable for its low saturated fat content. It offers a favorable balance of monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids along with good thermal stability.
description: Canola/Rapeseed Oil is a refined vegetable lipid extracted from oilseed rape and distinguished by its exceptionally low saturated fat content. It delivers a highly favorable ratio of monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids combined with excellent thermal stability. Offering a high smoke point and neutral sensory profile, it is suited for demanding high-temperature food processing and fluid blending in precision feed manufacturing.
application: High-temperature food processing; Precision feed manufacturing; Fluid blending applications
packing: Bulk: Tank Containers (22-23 MT), Flexi Tank (22-23 MT)

name: Soybean seed Oil
info: Soybean Seed Oil is a vegetable lipid extracted from soybeans and refined for consistent blending characteristics. It provides a balanced ratio of linoleic and oleic acids as a digestible source of energy and essential fatty acids.
description: Soybean Seed Oil is a highly functional vegetable lipid extracted from selected soybeans and refined for uniform blending characteristics. It provides a balanced concentration of linoleic and oleic acids, offering a highly bioavailable source of essential fatty acids and metabolic energy. It is utilized globally as a foundational macro-ingredient to improve emulsification in food systems and to drive caloric density and dust control in animal nutrition.
application: Emulsification in food systems; Energy densifier in animal feed; Dust control in feed manufacturing
packing: Bulk: Tank Containers (22-23 MT), Flexi Tank (22-23 MT)
specification: FFA (as oleic with a molecular weight of 282):1.00%
Colour (Lovibond cell 1 inch):50 yellow plus 5 red

name: Corn Oil
info: Corn Oil is a vegetable lipid extracted from corn germ and refined to a consistent, high-purity standard. It contains a high proportion of polyunsaturated fats and offers good frying stability and digestibility.
description: Corn Oil is a stable vegetable lipid extracted from corn germ and processed to achieve a reliable, high-purity profile. It is valued for its high concentration of polyunsaturated fats, excellent frying stability, and exceptional metabolic digestibility. With its elevated smoke point and clean character, it supports demanding food service applications while serving as a potent energy source for premium feed formulations.
application: Food service frying applications; Energy source in premium feed formulations; Carrier oil in feed manufacturing
packing: Bulk: Tank Containers (22-23 MT), Flexi Tank (22-23 MT)
specification: Colour lovibond (Basis yellow 50 – cell 25.4 cm):Red Max 6.50

name: Olive Oil
info: Olive Oil is a vegetable lipid extracted from olives and processed to preserve its natural composition. It's predominantly composed of oleic acid, a stable monounsaturated fat, along with naturally occurring antioxidants.
description: Olive Oil is a premium, high-value vegetable lipid extracted from olives and processed to preserve its distinct nutritional integrity. It is dominated by oleic acid, a highly stable monounsaturated fat, and naturally occurring antioxidant compounds. It is deployed primarily in premium culinary products, gourmet food manufacturing, and functional foods, where its strong health reputation and sensory profile add perceived value in premium product positioning.
application: Premium culinary and gourmet food products; Functional food formulations; Specialty dietary supplements
packing: Bulk: Tank Containers (22-23 MT), Flexi Tank (22-23 MT)

name: Palm Oil
info: Palm Oil is a vegetable lipid extracted from the fruit mesocarp of the oil palm and refined for thermal stability. Its semi-solid fatty acid composition provides oxidative resistance without requiring hydrogenation.
description: Palm Oil is a naturally structured vegetable lipid extracted from the fruit mesocarp of the oil palm and refined for robust thermal performance. It features a balanced, semi-solid fatty acid composition that provides excellent oxidative resistance without requiring chemical hydrogenation. It functions as a critical texturizing ingredient in the bakery, confectionery, and frying industries, delivering required structure and crispness to processed foods.
application: Bakery and confectionery manufacturing; Frying applications; Texturizing agent in processed foods
packing: Bulk: Tank Containers (22-23 MT), Flexi Tank (22-23 MT)

name: Palm Olein
info: Palm Olein is the liquid fraction of palm oil, separated through controlled fractionation. It remains fluid at ambient temperature and resists thermal breakdown during extended heating.
description: Palm Olein is the liquid fraction of palm oil, separated via controlled crystallization and advanced fractionation techniques. It is characterized by its clear fluidity at ambient temperatures and outstanding resistance to thermal breakdown during prolonged heating. This makes it the industry-standard lipid for high-throughput commercial frying, industrial food manufacturing, and retail cooking oil formulations.
application: Commercial and industrial frying; Retail cooking oil formulations; Food manufacturing
packing: Bulk, IBC Containers, Bottled (1l, 3l, 5l, 20l and other)

name: L-Lysine
info: L-Lysine is a high-purity essential amino acid produced through microbial fermentation. It's typically the first limiting amino acid in swine and poultry diets, supporting lean tissue growth and protein utilization.
description: L-Lysine is a high-purity essential amino acid produced via targeted microbial fermentation and refined for predictable performance. Operating typically as the first limiting amino acid in swine and a core driver of lean tissue deposition in poultry, it is a foundational pillar of precision animal nutrition. Its inclusion allows for the exact balancing of ideal protein profiles, enabling reduced crude protein formulation while optimizing feed conversion ratios (FCR).
application: Swine and poultry feed formulations; Reduced-crude-protein diet formulation; Feed conversion optimization programs

name: DL-Methionine
info: DL-Methionine is a chemically synthesized, sulfur-containing amino acid supplied for consistent metabolic availability. It's the primary limiting amino acid in poultry diets and supports feathering, immune function, and cellular growth.
description: DL-Methionine is a highly stable, chemically synthesized sulfur-containing amino acid designed for maximum metabolic bioavailability. It functions as the primary limiting amino acid in poultry diets and a vital nutrient in both aquaculture and high-yielding dairy formulations. Crucial for feathering, immune defense, and cellular growth, it allows nutritionists to formulate cost-optimized diets that maximize breast meat yield and overall flock performance.
application: Poultry feed formulations; Aquaculture diets; High-yielding dairy rations

name: L-Threonine
info: L-Threonine is a high-purity essential amino acid produced through industrial fermentation. It's a limiting amino acid in swine and poultry diets and supports intestinal integrity and immune function.
description: L-Threonine is a high-purity essential amino acid obtained through controlled industrial fermentation and processed for reliable nutritional delivery. It acts as a pivotal limiting amino acid in swine and poultry formulations, dictating the efficiency of overall dietary protein utilization. Beyond muscle synthesis, it is a critical component for maintaining intestinal mucosal integrity and supporting robust immune function in intensive production systems.
application: Swine and poultry feed formulations; Intensive production systems; Feed protein optimization

name: L-Tryptophan
info: L-Tryptophan is an essential amino acid produced through microbial fermentation and supplied in crystalline form. As a precursor to serotonin and melatonin, it helps regulate feed intake and supports stress response and immune function.
description: L-Tryptophan is a highly refined essential amino acid produced through precise microbial fermentation and supplied in crystalline form. It represents a key limiting amino acid necessary for achieving perfect protein balance in livestock and poultry compound feeds. As the direct physiological precursor to serotonin and melatonin, it is uniquely utilized to regulate voluntary feed intake, mitigate behavioral stress, and support immune responses.
application: Livestock and poultry compound feeds; Behavioral and stress management formulations; Protein-balanced diet programs

name: L-Valine
info: L-Valine is an essential branched-chain amino acid produced through industrial fermentation. It supports amino acid balance in livestock and poultry diets, particularly when crude protein levels are reduced.
description: L-Valine is an essential branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) produced via precision industrial fermentation and refined to strict purity standards. It serves as a critical limiting amino acid in advanced livestock and poultry diets, addressing branch-chain imbalances that occur when lowering crude protein. By improving the ideal amino acid ratio, it allows for highly optimized feed efficiency, maximizes lean meat yield, and reduces environmental nitrogen excretion.
application: Livestock and poultry feed formulations; Reduced-protein diet formulation; Feed efficiency programs

name: L-Arginine
info: L-Arginine is a high-purity essential amino acid produced through microbial fermentation. It plays a central role in nitrogen balance, ammonia removal, and growth hormone activity in animals.
description: L-Arginine is a high-purity essential amino acid manufactured through precision microbial fermentation and refined to deliver consistent nutritional performance. As a key substrate in animal metabolism, it supports nitrogen balance, ammonia detoxification through the urea cycle, and growth hormone stimulation. It is widely incorporated into premium poultry diets, specialized aquaculture feeds, and pet food formulations to promote cardiovascular health and robust immune function.
application: Premium poultry diets; Specialized aquaculture feeds; Pet food for cardiovascular and immune support

name: Taurine
info: Taurine is a chemically synthesized amino sulfonic acid known for its purity and consistency. Unlike typical amino acids, it isn't used to build protein, but instead supports bile function, heart performance, and eye health.
description: Taurine is a chemically synthesized organic amino sulfonic acid of high purity and stability, produced to strict quality standards for reliable, predictable supplementation. Unlike conventional amino acids, it does not participate in protein synthesis but serves as an essential functional nutrient involved in bile acid conjugation, cardiac performance, and retinal integrity. It is a mandatory inclusion in feline nutrition due to the cat's limited endogenous synthesis capacity, and is widely added to premium canine diets and aquaculture feeds to prevent deficiency-associated dilated cardiomyopathy.
application: Essential inclusion in feline diets; Premium canine diets; Aquaculture feeds, preventing heart-related deficiencies

name: Crystaline Fructose
info: Crystalline Fructose is a high-purity solid sweetener produced by crystallizing fructose from plant starch sources. It delivers intense sweetness with a clean taste and a lower glycemic impact than glucose or sucrose.
description: Crystalline Fructose is a high-purity, solid carbohydrate sweetener produced through the controlled crystallization of enriched fructose streams derived from plant starch. It delivers the highest relative sweetness of all naturally occurring nutritive sugars, paired with a clean sensory profile and a low glycemic index compared to glucose and sucrose. It is used as a functional sweetening and texturizing agent in premium food formulations, dry beverage mixes, and specialized animal transition diets where improved palatability is needed to encourage feed intake.
application: Sweetening agent in premium food products; Dry beverage mixes; Palatability enhancer in animal transition diets

name: Maltodextrins
info: Maltodextrins are digestible carbohydrates produced by the partial hydrolysis of food-grade starches, sourced from corn or potato. They offer low sweetness, high solubility, and strong moisture-binding properties.
description: Maltodextrins are easily digestible structural carbohydrates produced via the controlled partial hydrolysis of food-grade starches, sourced from corn or potato. They are characterized by their low sweetness profile, excellent solubility, and exceptional moisture-binding capabilities. Widely utilized as premium spray-drying carriers, bulking agents, and texture stabilizers, they provide reliable caloric density and mouthfeel optimization across both food applications and specialized animal milk replacers.
application: Spray-drying carrier applications; Bulking agent in food products; Animal milk replacer formulations

name: Glucose Fructose Sirups
info: Glucose-Fructose Syrup is an aqueous carbohydrate solution produced by the enzymatic hydrolysis of plant starch, containing more glucose than fructose. It provides moderate sweetness, humectancy, and resistance to crystallization.
description: Glucose-Fructose Syrup is a purified, aqueous carbohydrate solution derived from the enzymatic hydrolysis of plant starch, containing a higher proportion of glucose than fructose. It features a clean, moderate sweetness profile, high humectancy, and excellent anti-crystallization properties. Operating as a highly versatile texturizer and fermentable carbohydrate source, it is extensively deployed in beverage production, confectionery, baking, and liquid feed supplements requiring stable viscosity.
application: Beverage and confectionery production; Baking applications; Liquid feed supplements

name: High Fructose Corn Syrup
info: High Fructose Corn Syrup is a liquid sweetener produced through the enzymatic isomerization of corn (maize) starch-derived glucose into fructose, standardized to either 42% or 55% fructose content grades. It delivers strong sweetness with good hygroscopic properties that help preserve product freshness.
description: High Fructose Corn Syrup is a highly soluble liquid sweetener produced through the enzymatic isomerization of glucose into fructose, standardized to either 42% or 55% fructose content grades. It delivers a high relative sweetness profile with a clean, immediate flavor release and excellent hygroscopic properties that preserve product freshness. It functions as a foundational sweetening agent and humectant in high-volume food processing, commercial beverages, and specialized apiculture (bee) feeding systems.
application: High-volume food and beverage processing; Confectionery manufacturing; Apiculture (bee) feeding systems

name: Molasses
info: Molasses is a thick, energy-dense co-product of sugarcane or sugar beet refining. It supplies readily available carbohydrates along with natural sweetness and binding properties.
description: Molasses is a dense, viscous co-product of sugarcane or sugar beet refining and crystallization. It is characterized by a concentrated soluble carbohydrate content that provides a readily available energy source, along with natural palatability-enhancing properties and structural viscosity that make it a valuable binding agent. It finds broad application in feed pelleting, mineral lick blocks, and dust-suppression systems across the livestock and feed manufacturing sectors.
application: Energy source in livestock feed; Binding agent in feed pelleting; Mineral lick blocks; Dust suppression in feed manufacturing

name: Stevia
info: Stevia is a natural, zero-calorie sweetener extracted from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant and refined for high steviol glycoside content. It offers strong thermal and pH stability as a plant-based alternative to nutritive sugars.
description: Stevia is a high-intensity, zero-calorie natural sweetener extracted from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant and refined to high concentrations of sweet steviol glycosides (such as Rebaudioside A). It is distinguished by its exceptional thermal and pH stability, offering a potent, plant-based alternative to traditional nutritive sugars. It is primarily utilized in calorie-reduced food formulations, functional beverages, and premium health-conscious dietary products seeking a clean label status.
application: Calorie-reduced food formulations; Functional beverages; Clean-label dietary products

name: Aspartame
info: Aspartame is a non-nutritive artificial sweetener synthesized from L-aspartic acid and L-phenylalanine. It delivers sweetness roughly 200 times that of sucrose without the caloric contribution. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Phenylalanine.
description: Aspartame is a high-intensity, non-nutritive artificial sweetener synthesized from the joining of two amino acids: L-aspartic acid and L-phenylalanine. It features a highly efficient sweetness potency approximately 200 times greater than sucrose, with a sensory profile that closely mimics traditional sugar without any bitter aftertaste. It is widely incorporated into low-calorie beverages, dairy products, confectionery, and pharmaceutical formulations where intense sweetness must be achieved without adding caloric bulk.
application: Low-calorie beverages; Dairy products and confectionery; Pharmaceutical formulations

name: Wheat Starch
info: Wheat Starch is a native carbohydrate isolated from wheat flour through separation of gluten proteins. It has good swelling properties and forms soft, opaque gels upon cooking. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Wheat / Gluten.
description: Wheat Starch is a native plant carbohydrate isolated from wheat flour through the thorough physical separation of gluten proteins and refined to a high state of purity. It is valued for its unique swelling properties, clean white appearance, and its ability to form soft, opaque gels upon cooking. It acts as a critical thickening, binding, and texturizing agent in bakery products, prepared soups, and processed meats, while also serving as a premium carbohydrate source in calf milk replacers.
application: Bakery products and prepared soups; Processed meats; Calf milk replacers

name: Tapioca Starch
info: Tapioca Starch is a native, gluten-free carbohydrate extracted from cassava roots and refined for consistent functional performance. It has a bland flavor profile and forms a clear, elastic gel.
description: Tapioca Starch is a native, gluten-free carbohydrate extracted from the storage roots of the cassava plant (Manihot esculenta) and refined for uniform functional performance. It is characterized by its exceptionally bland flavor profile, high paste clarity, and a distinct elastic, cohesive gel texture. It is highly sought after as a clean-label thickener, binder, and stabilizer in moisture-sensitive food formulations, gluten-free baking, and premium pet food applications requiring excellent digestibility.
application: Gluten-free baking; Moisture-sensitive food formulations; Premium pet food applications

name: Rice Starch
info: Rice Starch is a hypoallergenic native carbohydrate extracted from rice grains, characterized by its very small granule size. It provides a creamy mouthfeel, freeze-thaw stability, and a smooth surface finish.
description: Rice Starch is a premium, hypoallergenic native carbohydrate extracted from rice grains and characterized by its ultra-small granule size (typically 2 to 8 microns). This microscopic structure allows it to mimic the creamy mouthfeel of fats while providing excellent freeze-thaw stability and a smooth, glossy surface finish. It is utilized as a high-tier texturizer, fat replacer, and clean-label stabilizer in baby foods, sensitive clinical nutrition products, organic dairy formulations, and specialized animal weaning diets.
application: Baby food and clinical nutrition products; Organic dairy formulations; Specialized animal weaning diets

name: Soybean Meal 46%
info: Soybean Meal 46% is a high-protein ingredient produced by extracting oil from soybeans and toasting the remaining meal. It delivers a dense, well-digestible amino acid profile particularly rich in lysine. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Soy.
description: Soybean Meal 46% is a high-protein macro-ingredient produced through solvent extraction of oil from selected soybeans, followed by toasting to optimize nutritional availability. It is characterized by a dense crude protein content and a well-digestible amino acid profile particularly rich in lysine. As the global benchmark for plant-based protein supplementation, it is foundational in poultry, swine, and ruminant rations formulated to maximize muscle deposition and overall performance efficiency.
application: Poultry rations; Swine diets; Ruminant feed formulations

name: SoyPro
info: SOYPRO is a refined plant protein concentrate produced from defatted soybean flakes. Processing removes anti-nutritional factors, resulting in a highly digestible protein source with a minimum of 65% protein content. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Soy.
description: SOYPRO is a premium functional plant protein concentrate produced from defatted soybean flakes through aqueous alcohol extraction targeting soluble carbohydrates. This processing step removes anti-nutritional factors and oligosaccharides, yielding a minimum 65% protein content with superior ileal digestibility. The result is a clean, highly bioavailable protein source engineered for use in milk replacers, weaning piglet diets, aquafeed, and sensitive pet food applications where gut tolerance and nutrient uptake are priorities.
application: Milk replacers; Weaning piglet diets; Aquafeed; Sensitive pet food formulations

name: Sunflower Meal 36%
info: Sunflower Meal 36% is a protein and fiber-rich ingredient produced by pressing and extracting oil from sunflower seeds. It offers good palatability along with a favorable methionine content.
description: Sunflower Meal 36% is a nutrient-dense feed ingredient produced by the mechanical pressing and solvent extraction of oil from sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuus). It delivers a reliable 36% crude protein content with a favorable methionine profile, though with naturally low lysine levels. With good palatability and a substantial fiber fraction, it serves as a cost-effective protein and structural fiber component in ruminant rations, swine diets, and layer poultry formulations.
application: Ruminant rations; Swine diets; Layer poultry formulations

name: Canola/Rapeseed Meal
info: Canola/Rapeseed Meal is a co-product of oil extraction from canola or low-glucosinolate rapeseed. It provides a well-balanced amino acid profile, notably rich in sulfur-containing amino acids.
description: Canola/Rapeseed Meal is a quality oilseed co-product obtained through the crushing and solvent extraction of oil from canola or low-glucosinolate rapeseed varieties. It offers a well-balanced amino acid profile with notable concentrations of sulfur-containing amino acids (methionine and cysteine) and good metabolic bioavailability. It is widely used as a protein extender in dairy cattle rations to support milk yields, and features across commercial poultry and swine formulations.
application: Protein extender in dairy cattle rations; Poultry formulations; Swine feed

name: Corn Gluten Meal
info: Corn Gluten Meal is a high-protein co-product separated during the wet-milling of corn. Its natural xanthophyll content gives it valuable pigmenting properties alongside high energy value.
description: Corn Gluten Meal (CGM) is a premium, high-protein co-product isolated during the wet-milling of corn (Zea mays) after the separation of starch, germ, and bran. It is characterized by a high crude protein concentration (typically 60%), elevated metabolizable energy, and a rich natural xanthophyll content, making it a valued pigmenting agent in poultry feeds for enhancing skin and yolk coloration. It is also used as a digestible protein source in premium aquaculture and pet food applications.
application: Poultry feed for skin and yolk coloration; Aquaculture diets; Premium pet food

name: Wheat Gluten
info: Wheat Gluten is a functional plant protein isolated from wheat flour, valued for its strong binding and water-absorption properties. It helps maintain shape, texture, and cohesion in processed feed and food products. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Wheat / Gluten.
description: Wheat Gluten is a functional plant protein concentrate isolated from wheat flour through the physical separation of starch fractions, followed by gentle drying to preserve its native viscoelastic properties. It is distinguished by its high-water absorption capacity, binding strength, and a crude protein content typically exceeding 75–80%. These properties make it an indispensable texturizing and binding matrix in high-performance aquafeeds (including shrimp and salmon pellets), wet pet food applications, and specialized bakery products.
application: Binding matrix in aquafeed (shrimp and salmon pellets); Wet pet food; Specialized bakery products

name: Sugar Beet Pellets
info: Sugar Beet Pellets are a fibrous, highly digestible co-product remaining after sugar extraction from sugar beets. They provide fermentable fiber that supports healthy gut function.
description: Sugar Beet Pellets are a highly digestible, fibrous co-product produced by drying and pelleting the exhausted root slices remaining after the extraction of sugar from sugar beets (Beta vulgaris). They feature a carbohydrate profile rich in pectins and hemicellulose, offering a fermentable fiber source that supports beneficial volatile fatty acid production in the hindgut. Their low-dust handling characteristics and moderate energy contribution make them a practical structural energy ingredient in equine diets, dairy rations, and beef cattle feeding programs.
application: Equine diets; Dairy rations; Beef cattle feeding programs

name: Corn DDGS
info: Corn DDGS is a nutrient-dense co-product of corn-based ethanol production, combining protein, fiber, fat, and vitamins in concentrated form. It serves as a cost-effective energy and protein source in compound feed formulations.
description: Corn DDGS is a nutrient-dense co-product of corn-based industrial ethanol production, formed by combining dried spent grains with condensed distillers solubles after multi-stage distillation. The fermentation process removes starch, concentrating the remaining protein, lipid, fiber, and vitamin fractions by approximately threefold relative to raw corn grain. It serves as a versatile and economical multi-nutritional ingredient supplying both bypass protein and metabolizable energy across dairy, beef, swine, and poultry diets.
application: Dairy and beef cattle diets; Swine feed; Poultry rations

name: Wheat Middlings
info: Wheat Middlings are a milling co-product made up of bran, shorts, germ, and flour particles. They offer a balanced mix of protein, carbohydrates, and dietary fiber. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Wheat / Gluten.
description: Wheat Middlings are a versatile milling co-product consisting of fine particles of wheat bran, wheat shorts, wheat germ, and flour fragments separated during the industrial milling of wheat for human consumption. They provide a balanced nutritional matrix combining a moderate 15–17% crude protein content, available carbohydrates, and functional dietary fiber. Their good palatability and pelleting characteristics make them a practical, cost-effective bulk ingredient across commercial livestock, poultry, and compound feed manufacturing.
application: Livestock feed; Poultry diets; Compound feed manufacturing

name: Fish Meal
info: Fish Meal is a high-protein ingredient produced by cooking, pressing, and drying whole fish or fish trimmings. It offers an outstanding amino acid profile along with natural omega-3 fatty acids. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Fish.
description: Fish Meal is a high-protein animal-derived ingredient produced through the cooking, pressing, drying, and milling of whole fish or fish trimmings, typically sourced from anchovy, herring, menhaden, or white fish species. It delivers a crude protein content ranging from 60–72%, accompanied by an outstanding amino acid profile with high concentrations of lysine, methionine, and threonine, as well as elevated levels of natural omega-3 fatty acids and ash-bound phosphorus. It serves as a benchmark digestible protein and palatability-enhancing ingredient in aquaculture feeds, starter piglet diets, poultry formulations, and premium pet foods.
application: Aquaculture feeds; Starter piglet diets; Poultry formulations; Premium pet food

name: Fish Oil/Salmon Oil
info: Fish Oil is a refined marine lipid extracted from whole fish or fish byproducts, rich in the long-chain omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA. It supports cardiovascular, cognitive, and skin/coat health across species. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Fish.
description: Fish Oil / Salmon Oil is a refined marine lipid extracted from whole fish or fish byproducts through cooking and centrifugal separation, then processed to ensure oxidative stability and consistent fatty acid delivery. It is the most concentrated natural source of long-chain omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids, particularly eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), which are essential for neural development, anti-inflammatory response, cardiovascular function, and skin and coat integrity. It is a standard inclusion in salmon and marine finfish aquafeeds, premium canine and feline diets, and functional food supplements.
application: Salmon and marine finfish aquafeeds; Premium canine and feline diets; Functional food supplements
packing: Bulk, IBC Containers, Bottled (1l, 3l, 5l, 20l and other)

name: Poultry Meal
info: Poultry Meal is a concentrated animal protein produced by rendering clean poultry tissue. It offers a well-digestible amino acid profile at a cost-effective price point.
description: Poultry Meal is a concentrated animal protein ingredient produced through the rendering of clean poultry tissues, including carcass, neck, feet, and undeveloped eggs, excluding feathers. The rendering process involves thermal cooking, fat separation, and milling to a homogenous powder, yielding a crude protein content typically between 60–65% with a well-digestible amino acid profile. It is widely used as a cost-effective and palatable protein source in commercial pet food manufacturing, poultry and swine compound feeds, and aquaculture starter diets.
application: Pet food manufacturing; Poultry and swine compound feeds; Aquaculture starter diets

name: Blood Meal
info: Blood Meal is a high-nitrogen protein ingredient produced by drying fresh animal blood. It's among the most concentrated protein sources available, led by its lysine content.
description: Blood Meal is a high-nitrogen animal protein ingredient produced by spray-drying or ring-drying fresh blood collected at licensed slaughter facilities. It delivers one of the highest crude protein concentrations available in feed-grade ingredients, typically 85–92%, with lysine as its dominant amino acid. Its rapid gastrointestinal transit rate limits inclusion levels, but it serves as a targeted lysine supplement and palatability modifier in swine starter diets, aquaculture feeds, and ruminant rations where high-protein density is required.
application: Swine starter diets; Aquaculture feeds; Ruminant rations

name: Soy Protein Concentrate
info: Soy Protein Concentrate is a refined plant protein produced from defatted soybean flakes, processed to remove soluble sugars and reduce anti-nutritional factors. It provides a highly digestible protein source well-suited to sensitive digestive systems. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Soy.
description: Soy Protein Concentrate is a refined plant protein ingredient produced from dehulled, defatted soybean flakes through aqueous alcohol or water washing to remove soluble sugars and reduce anti-nutritional factors. The process yields a minimum 65% crude protein content on a dry matter basis, with significantly reduced oligosaccharide and trypsin inhibitor levels compared to standard soybean meal. It is used as a digestible, low-antinutrient protein source in weaning piglet diets, salmonid aquafeeds, and specialty pet food formulations where soy is included at higher levels and gut sensitivity is a concern.
application: Weaning piglet diets; Salmonid aquafeeds; Specialty pet food formulations

name: Pea Protein
info: Pea Protein is a plant-derived protein concentrate extracted from yellow peas. It's naturally free from gluten, soy, and dairy, with low allergenicity.
description: Pea Protein is a plant-derived protein concentrate produced through wet fractionation of yellow peas (Pisum sativum), separating the protein fraction from starch and fiber components. It typically delivers 80–85% crude protein on a dry matter basis, with a favorable amino acid profile characterized by adequate lysine content and naturally low allergenicity. Free from the major regulated allergens (gluten, soy, dairy), it is widely incorporated into grain-free and novel-protein pet food formulations, vegetarian aquafeeds, and functional human food products.
application: Grain-free and novel-protein pet food; Vegetarian aquafeeds; Functional human food products

name: Potato Protein
info: Potato Protein is a plant-derived protein concentrate isolated from potato juice during starch extraction. It offers a strong amino acid profile rich in lysine, threonine, and methionine, along with high digestibility.
description: Potato Protein is a high-quality, plant-derived protein concentrate isolated from potato juice during starch extraction and refined to a high state of purity. It is characterized by an exceptional amino acid profile rich in lysine, threonine, and methionine, alongside high ileal digestibility. With anti-nutritional factors that are eliminated through processing and naturally hypoallergenic, it serves as a premium macro-ingredient in weaning piglets, aquaculture feeds, and specialized pet food formulations requiring highly concentrated, easily digestible protein.
application: Weaning piglet diets; Aquaculture feeds; Specialized pet food formulations

name: Rice Protein
info: Rice Protein is a vegetable protein concentrate isolated from rice grains through enzymatic separation of carbohydrates and lipids. It has a balanced amino acid profile, low molecular weight, and hypoallergenic properties.
description: Rice Protein is a premium vegetable protein concentrate isolated from brown or white rice grains through precise enzymatic separation of carbohydrates and lipids. It features an excellent, balanced amino acid profile with high bioavailability and a low molecular weight that minimizes gastrointestinal stress. Recognized for its hypoallergenic properties and neutral flavor, it is extensively deployed in infant nutrition, plant-based foods, premium pet diets, and specialized early-stage livestock starter feeds.
application: Infant nutrition; Plant-based food products; Premium pet diets and livestock starter feeds

name: Poultry By-Product Meal
info: Poultry By-Product Meal is an animal protein source rendered from clean parts of poultry carcasses, including necks, feet, and undeveloped eggs. It provides a balanced supply of amino acids, fatty acids, and metabolizable energy.
description: Poultry By-Product Meal is a highly bioavailable animal protein source rendered from clean parts of the carcasses of slaughtered poultry, including necks, feet, and undeveloped eggs. It delivers an excellent balance of essential amino acids, essential fatty acids, and highly metabolizable energy. Characterized by low ash content and high palatability, it functions as a foundational, cost-effective macro-ingredient in premium aquaculture feeds, pet food manufacturing, and intensive livestock nutrition.
application: Aquaculture feeds; Pet food manufacturing; Intensive livestock nutrition

name: Hydrolyzed Feather Meal
info: Hydrolyzed Feather Meal is an animal protein source produced by the hydrothermal treatment and grinding of clean poultry feathers. Processing breaks down keratin's disulfide bonds, yielding a digestible protein rich in cysteine, glycine, and arginine.
description: Hydrolyzed Feather Meal is a concentrated animal protein source produced by the controlled hydrothermal treatment and grinding of clean poultry feathers. The intense pressure-cooking process breaks the rigid disulfide bonds of keratin, transforming it into a highly digestible protein matrix rich in cysteine, glycine, and arginine. It serves as an economical, highly efficient protein extender and nitrogen source in ruminant rations, aquaculture diets, and pet food formulations requiring high protein density.
application: Ruminant rations; Aquaculture diets; Pet food formulations

name: Insect Meal
info: Insect Meal is a sustainable animal protein produced from farm-raised Black Soldier Fly larvae or mealworms fed on approved vegetable substrates. It offers a favorable fatty acid profile and naturally occurring chitin.
description: Insect Meal is an emerging, sustainable animal protein ingredient produced from whole dried and milled insects, either black soldier fly larvae (Hermetia illucens) or mealworm (Tenebrio molitor). It delivers a crude protein content of 40–60% alongside a favorable fatty acid profile, naturally occurring antimicrobial peptides, and chitin, a structural polysaccharide with prebiotic activity in the gastrointestinal tract. It is gaining regulatory approval and commercial adoption across premium aquaculture feeds, poultry diets, and companion animal nutrition as a traceable, low-land-use alternative to conventional animal proteins.
application: Premium aquaculture feeds; Poultry diets; Companion animal nutrition

name: Meat and Bone Meal
info: Meat and Bone Meal is a rendered animal protein product derived from mammalian tissue, including bone, processed under thermal sterilization standards. It supplies protein, essential lipids, and bioavailable calcium and phosphorus.
description: Meat and Bone Meal (MBM) is a nutrient-dense, rendered animal protein product derived from mammalian tissue, inclusive of bone, and processed under strict thermal sterilization standards. It provides a potent combination of high-crude protein, essential lipids, and a highly bioavailable source of macrominerals, specifically calcium and phosphorus. It is utilized as a vital structural component in pet food manufacturing, poultry nutrition, and aquaculture to deliver cost-effective energy and mineral balancing.
application: Pet food manufacturing; Poultry nutrition; Aquaculture feed formulations

name: Krill Meal
info: Krill Meal is a marine lipid and protein concentrate produced from sustainably harvested Antarctic krill, stabilized and dried shortly after harvest. It contains omega-3 fatty acids bound to phospholipids along with natural astaxanthin pigment. Allergen Disclosure: Contains Crustacean/Shellfish.
description: Krill Meal is a premium marine lipid and protein concentrate produced from sustainably harvested Antarctic krill (Euphausia superba), immediately stabilized and dried. It is characterized by its high concentrations of omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA) bound to phospholipids, its natural astaxanthin pigment, and powerful feeding stimulants. It functions as an exceptional palatability enhancer, health promoter, and pigmentation agent in high-tier aquaculture feeds, premium pet foods, and specialized animal health formulas.
application: High-tier aquaculture feeds; Premium pet foods; Specialized animal health formulas

name: Choline Chloride
info: Choline Chloride is a synthesized organic compound supplied as a liquid or deposited on a corn cob carrier. It supplies choline, a nutrient involved in lipid metabolism, cell membrane structure, and neurotransmitter synthesis.
description: Choline Chloride is a highly stable, chemically synthesized organic compound supplied fluid liquid or deposited on a corn cob carrier. It acts as a critical source of choline, a vital water-soluble nutrient essential for lipid metabolism, cellular membrane structure (lecithin), and neurotransmitter synthesis (acetylcholine). It is a universal, mandatory micro-ingredient added to premixes across all livestock, poultry, aquaculture, and pet nutrition sectors to prevent fatty liver syndrome and support optimal growth.
application: Premix formulations across livestock, poultry, and aquaculture; Pet nutrition; Fatty liver prevention programs

name: Vitamin C
info: Vitamin C is a water-soluble antioxidant vitamin, available in stabilized coated forms for improved shelf life and processing tolerance. It supports immune function and connective tissue integrity.
description: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) is a water-soluble antioxidant vitamin available in stabilized coated forms for improved shelf life and processing tolerance. It supports immune function, connective tissue integrity, iron absorption, and antioxidant defense, and is dietary-essential in species unable to synthesize it independently, including fish, guinea pigs, and humans. It is a standard inclusion in aquaculture feeds, poultry and swine premixes, and functional food and nutraceutical applications.
application: Aquaculture feeds; Poultry and swine premixes; Functional food and nutraceutical products

name: Inositol
info: Inositol is a naturally occurring cyclic sugar alcohol from the B-vitamin family. It supports cell membrane function and fluid regulation, and is especially important for aquatic species.
description: Inositol is a naturally occurring cyclic sugar alcohol classified within the B-vitamin complex, produced from plant-derived phytic acid. It plays an important role in cell membrane function, lipid metabolism, and fluid regulation, making it a dietary-essential nutrient for many aquatic species. It is a required inclusion in marine finfish and shrimp feeds, where deficiency is associated with fin erosion, poor growth, and impaired fat metabolism, and is also used in poultry premixes and functional food formulations.
application: Marine finfish and shrimp feeds; Poultry premixes; Functional food formulations

name: Vitamin E
info: Vitamin E is a fat-soluble antioxidant vitamin, supplied as dl-alpha-tocopheryl acetate on a vegetable-based carrier. It protects cell membranes from oxidative damage and supports immune function.
description: Vitamin E (Alpha-Tocopherol) is a fat-soluble antioxidant vitamin supplied as dl-alpha-tocopheryl acetate on a vegetable-based carrier. It protects cell membranes and dietary fats from oxidative damage, supports immune function, and contributes to reproductive performance. It is a critical inclusion in all compound feed premixes, particularly in diets rich in marine oils, and is widely used in human dietary supplements and functional food fortification.
application: All compound feed premixes; Diets rich in marine oils; Human dietary supplements

name: Niacin (B3)
info: Niacin is a water-soluble B-vitamin involved in energy metabolism and cellular function across all species. It supports healthy skin, coat, and gastrointestinal function while aiding the release of energy from feed.
description: Niacin (Vitamin B3) is a water-soluble B-vitamin available commercially as nicotinic acid or nicotinamide, produced through chemical synthesis or fermentation. It plays a central role in energy metabolism and cellular function across all species, and deficiency leads to characteristic conditions such as pellagra in humans and black tongue in dogs. It is a standard component of all vitamin premixes for livestock, poultry, aquaculture, and companion animals, as well as a regulated enrichment nutrient in human staple foods.
application: Livestock, poultry, and aquaculture premixes; Companion animal feed; Human staple food enrichment

name: Pantothenic Acid (B5)
info: Pantothenic Acid is a water-soluble B-vitamin, commercially supplied as calcium D-pantothenate. It supports energy metabolism, fat synthesis, and hormone production.
description: Pantothenic Acid (Vitamin B5) is a water-soluble B-vitamin commercially supplied as calcium D-pantothenate, the stable salt form produced through chemical synthesis. It is involved in energy metabolism, fat synthesis, and hormone production, making it essential for growth, reproduction, and overall metabolic health across all species. Deficiency manifests as impaired growth, reproductive failure, and skin lesions in swine and poultry; it is a required inclusion across all compound feed and food-grade vitamin premixes.
application: Compound feed premixes across all species; Food-grade vitamin premixes

name: Vitamin A, D3, K3
info: This is a stabilized blend of three fat-soluble vitamins, formulated for consistent potency. Together, they support epithelial health, bone development, and blood clotting.
description: Vitamin A, D3, K3 Complex is a stabilized fat-soluble vitamin premix combining retinyl acetate or palmitate, cholecalciferol, and menadione in a microencapsulated matrix formulated for consistent potency and handling stability. The three components work in a complementary physiological axis, collectively supporting epithelial integrity, calcium and phosphorus balance, bone development, and coagulation function across all major production species. Formulated to customer-specified activity levels, it serves as a practical and storage-stable solution for the simultaneous delivery of three essential fat-soluble vitamins in compound feed, aquaculture, and pet food manufacturing.
application: Compound feed; Aquaculture feed; Pet food manufacturing

name: Vitamin B1, B2, B6
info: This is a co-milled B-vitamin blend (Thiamine / Riboflavin / Pyridoxine) supplied as a uniform crystalline powder. It supports energy metabolism, nervous system function, and protein utilization.
description: Vitamin B1, B2, B6 Blend (Thiamine / Riboflavin / Pyridoxine) is a co-milled water-soluble B-vitamin combination supplied as a uniform crystalline powder at feed- and food-grade purity. It delivers coordinated support across energy metabolism, nervous system function, and protein utilization, areas where B-complex deficiencies most commonly affect animal performance and health. It is used as a convenient single-point B-vitamin inclusion in livestock, poultry, aquaculture, and companion animal premixes, as well as human food fortification applications.
application: Livestock and poultry premixes; Aquaculture feed; Human food fortification

name: Folic Acid (B9)
info: Folic Acid is a water-soluble B-vitamin essential for cell division and tissue growth, particularly during reproduction and early development. It supports fertility, fetal development, and healthy offspring outcomes.
description: Folic Acid (Vitamin B9) is a water-soluble B-vitamin produced through chemical synthesis and supplied in feed- and food-grade specifications. It is essential for cell division and tissue growth, making it particularly important during reproduction and early development. It is a key inclusion in sow and broiler breeder diets to support litter size and embryonic health and is a mandated fortification nutrient in human cereal and grain products in numerous regulatory jurisdictions.
application: Sow and broiler breeder diets; Human cereal and grain fortification

name: Biotin (H)
info: Biotin is a water-soluble B-vitamin supporting fat and carbohydrate metabolism, along with skin and tissue integrity. It's especially valued for its role in maintaining strong hooves, healthy skin, and coat quality.
description: Biotin (Vitamin B7) is a water-soluble B-vitamin produced through chemical synthesis and supplied in crystalline form or as a diluted premix carrier blend. It supports fat and carbohydrate metabolism, skin and tissue integrity, and reproductive health across all major species. In livestock nutrition, it is closely associated with hoof and claw quality in sows and dairy cows, where supplementation is well established for reducing lameness; it is also widely included in poultry, aquaculture, and companion animal premixes, and in human hair and nail supplement formulations.
application: Dairy cow and sow diets, supporting hoof health; Poultry and aquaculture premixes; Human hair and nail supplements

name: Vitamin B12
info: Vitamin B12 is a cobalt-containing B-vitamin produced exclusively through microbial fermentation. It's essential for red blood cell formation and nervous system integrity.
description: Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) is a water-soluble, cobalt-containing B-vitamin produced exclusively through microbial fermentation. It supports red blood cell formation, nervous system integrity, and the efficient metabolism of proteins and fats, and is dietary-essential in all monogastric species and fish, where intestinal synthesis is insufficient to meet requirements. It is an indispensable inclusion in compound feed premixes across all production categories and is the defining required supplement in vegan and vegetarian human diets.
application: Compound feed premixes across all production categories; Vegan and vegetarian human diet supplementation

name: FiberZ
info: FiberZ is a soluble dietary fiber produced from non-GMO Serbian wheat starch. It functions as a prebiotic substrate while improving texture and reducing the caloric density of finished products. Allergen Disclosure: May contain gluten (wheat).
description: FiberZ (Wheat Resistant Dextrin) is a soluble plant-based dietary fiber produced through thermochemical modification of non-GMO wheat starch sourced exclusively from domestic Serbian wheat, supplied as a fine, light-brown free-flowing powder with a dietary fiber content exceeding 50%. It functions as a prebiotic substrate supporting beneficial gut bacteria, while also contributing water retention, texture stability, and reduced caloric density to finished formulations. It is used across a broad range of food applications including baked goods, dairy products, beverages, soups, sauces, and instant and functional food products, as well as in the animal feed sector including pet food and aquafeed.
application: Baked goods, dairy products, and beverages; Soups and sauces; Pet food and aquafeed

name: FiberX
info: FiberX is an insoluble dietary fiber produced from non-GMO Serbian wheat starch. It supports gut health, improves satiety, and lowers the caloric contribution of finished products. Allergen Disclosure: May contain gluten (wheat).
description: FiberX (Wheat Resistant Starch) is an insoluble plant-based dietary fiber produced through thermochemical modification of non-GMO wheat starch sourced exclusively from domestic Serbian wheat, supplied as a fine white powder with a dietary fiber content exceeding 85%. It supports gut health as a prebiotic substrate, improves satiety, and lowers the caloric contribution of finished products, making it particularly suited to reduced-sugar, low-carb, and keto-oriented formulations. It is used across milling, baking, confectionery, pasta, dairy, and meat processing applications, as well as in cattle feed, pet food, and aquafeed.
application: Reduced-sugar, low-carb, and keto-oriented formulations; Milling, baking, and dairy applications; Cattle feed, pet food, and aquafeed

name: White Wheat Dextrin
info: White Wheat Dextrin is a partially water-soluble carbohydrate with a mild, neutral flavor, produced through controlled dry conversion of wheat starch. It functions as a thickener, binder, and texture stabilizer. Allergen Disclosure: May contain gluten (wheat).
description: White Wheat Dextrin is a partially water-soluble carbohydrate ingredient produced through the controlled dry thermochemical conversion of wheat starch, supplied as a fine white powder with a mild, neutral flavor profile. It functions as a thickener, binder, and texture stabilizer in food formulations, and serves as an effective carrier for dry blends, spice mixes, and encapsulated ingredients due to its low hygroscopicity and good dispersibility. It finds broad application in the food industry across baked goods, soups, sauces, and instant products, and is also used as a functional binder in pharmaceutical tablet manufacturing, paper and cardboard production, and adhesive formulations.
application: Baked goods, soups, and sauces; Pharmaceutical tablet manufacturing; Paper, cardboard, and adhesive production
packing: 25 kg white kraft bags with PE layer (1,000 kg/pallet, stretch-wrapped); 1,000 kg PP bags
specification: Allergen: May contain traces of gluten
Certifications: HACCP, ISO 9001:2015, IFS v08, Halal, Kosher

name: Yellow Wheat Dextrin
info: Yellow Wheat Dextrin is a fully water-soluble carbohydrate produced through more intensive roasting of wheat starch, giving it strong binding and film-forming properties. Allergen Disclosure: May contain gluten (wheat).
description: Yellow Wheat Dextrin is a fully water-soluble carbohydrate produced through more intensive thermochemical roasting of wheat starch, which drives greater molecular rearrangement and yields a characteristic yellow color and pronounced adhesive properties. Its high solubility and strong film-forming capacity make it a versatile carrier and stabilizer in powder food products such as instant soups, dry beverages, and spice blends, while its binding strength supports broad industrial use in paper, textile, foundry, and construction applications. It is supplied as a fine yellow powder and represents a cost-effective, plant-derived alternative to synthetic adhesives and binders across multiple sectors.
application: Instant soups, dry beverages, and spice blends; Paper, textile, and foundry industries
packing: 25 kg white kraft bags with PE layer (1,000 kg/pallet, stretch-wrapped); 1,000 kg PP bags
specification: Allergen: May contain traces of gluten
Certifications: HACCP, ISO 9001:2015, IFS v08, Halal, Kosher

name: Blue Wheat Dextrin
info: Blue Wheat Dextrin is a technical-grade carbohydrate produced through high-temperature conversion of wheat starch, resulting in strong adhesive and film-forming properties for industrial use.
description: Blue Wheat Dextrin is a technical-grade carbohydrate produced through high-temperature dry conversion of wheat starch under controlled roasting conditions, resulting in a deeply converted, highly branched dextrin with strong adhesive and film-forming properties. It is supplied as a powder for industrial use and serves as a functional binder and coating agent in demanding non-food applications including foundry, pyrotechnic, mining, and grinding stone industries where high bond strength and thermal stability are required. It represents a natural, starch-derived alternative to synthetic industrial binders in specialized manufacturing processes.
application: Foundry and pyrotechnic industries; Mining and grinding stone applications
packing: 25 kg white kraft bags with PE layer (1,000 kg/pallet, stretch-wrapped); 1,000 kg PP bags
specification: Allergen: May contain traces of gluten
Certifications: HACCP, ISO 9001:2015, IFS v08, Halal, Kosher

name: Glycerins - Raw and Refined
info: Glycerin is a polyol compound derived as a co-product of biodiesel production and fat splitting. It exists in both crude (raw) and purified (refined) grades.
description: Raw glycerin is an economical energy source used in ruminant and swine diets to replace grain-based energy. Refined glycerin (min 99.5% purity) is a high-purity, versatile humectant used as a functional ingredient in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and technical applications including oleochemical synthesis.
application: Energy co-product in animal feed; humectant in cosmetics/pharma; raw material for alkyd resins and polyols in oleochemical applications.

name: Bovine Fats
info: Bovine fat is a rendered animal fat derived from cattle tissues. It is a rich source of saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids.
description: Bovine fat is a versatile raw material for the oleochemical industry, characterized by its high tallow content and consistent fatty acid profile. It serves as a feedstock for the production of fatty acids, fatty alcohols, soaps, and lubricants through saponification and splitting processes.
application: Feedstock for fatty acid and fatty alcohol production; base for industrial soaps, lubricants, and candles; raw material for surfactant and detergent manufacturing.
specification: Appearance: solid to semi-solid, light yellow to white

name: Pork Fats
info: Pork fat (lard) is a rendered fat derived from porcine adipose tissue. It has a distinctive fatty acid profile high in oleic acid.
description: Pork fat is a raw material for oleochemical applications characterized by its softer texture and high oleic acid content compared to bovine tallow. It is processed through splitting and hydrogenation to produce fatty acids and derivatives used in soap, cosmetics, and industrial lubricant manufacturing.
application: Oleochemical feedstock for soap and detergent production; precursor for fatty acids used in cosmetics and personal care; industrial lubricant and release agent base.
specification: Appearance: soft solid to semi-liquid, white to cream

name: Mixed Animal Fats
info: Mixed animal fats are a blend of rendered animal-origin lipids from various species. They serve as a cost-effective biofuel feedstock.
description: Mixed animal fats are a high-energy, multi-origin lipid blend characterized by their suitability as a feedstock for Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil (HVO) and Fatty Acid Methyl Ester (FAME) biodiesel production. They are classified under Annex IX of the EU Renewable Energy Directive (RED II) and qualify for double-counting toward renewable fuel targets.
application: Primary feedstock for HVO (Renewable Diesel) and FAME (Biodiesel) production; contributes to RED II compliance and double-counting renewable energy targets.

name: Poultry Fats
info: Poultry fat is a rendered fat from chicken, turkey, and duck processing. It is an Annex IX advanced biofuel feedstock under EU RED II.
description: Poultry fat is a biofuel feedstock characterized by a relatively high unsaturated fatty acid content and eligibility for double-counting under RED II. Its lower titre point makes it more fluid at ambient temperatures, facilitating easier handling and processing into HVO and FAME.
application: Advanced biofuel feedstock for HVO/FAME; Annex IX double-counting eligible; cold-climate handling advantage due to low titre.

name: Fatty Acids
info: Fatty acids for biofuel are free fatty acid streams derived from fat splitting, distillation, or refining. They are a direct feedstock for FAME and HVO production.
description: Technical-grade fatty acids are characterized by their high free fatty acid content and suitability for direct transesterification into biodiesel. They originate from palm, tallow, or mixed vegetable/animal oil refining and provide a cost-effective route to renewable fuel production.
application: Direct feedstock for FAME biodiesel (acid-catalyzed esterification); pre-treatment feed for HVO units; chemical intermediate for lubricants and plasticizers.

name: Distillers Corn Oil (DCO)
info: Distillers Corn Oil (DCO) is a co-product extracted from the thin stillage of corn ethanol production. It is a polyunsaturated oil rich in linoleic acid.
description: DCO is characterized by its dual role as a biofuel feedstock and a high-energy animal feed ingredient. It qualifies as an Annex IX feedstock under EU RED II for double-counting toward advanced biofuel targets, offering competitive GHG savings. In feed applications, it delivers elevated metabolizable energy levels.
application: Advanced biofuel feedstock (HVO/FAME) with RED II Annex IX eligibility; high-energy feed supplement for poultry and swine; corn ethanol biorefinery by-product.
specification: Appearance: dark amber to brown liquid

name: Palm Fatty Acid Distillate (PFAD)
info: Palm Fatty Acid Distillate (PFAD) is a byproduct of palm oil refining. It is a mixture of free fatty acids, glycerides, and minor components collected during physical refining.
description: PFAD is a cost-effective SAF and biofuel feedstock characterized by its high free fatty acid content and palm origin. Under the CORSIA and RED III frameworks, PFAD from certified sustainable sources qualifies as a SAF feedstock, providing significant lifecycle GHG reductions compared to fossil jet fuel.
application: SAF feedstock via HEFA pathway; FAME biodiesel production; oleochemical feedstock for soap and fatty acid manufacturing.

name: Palm Oil Mill Effluent (POME)
info: Palm Oil Mill Effluent (POME) is the wastewater generated during palm oil processing. After treatment, the captured biogas or residual oil fraction serves as a SAF feedstock.
description: POME-derived biogas and extracted oil are advanced SAF feedstocks classified under RED II Annex IX and CORSIA Annex S1. The POME pathway delivers among the highest GHG savings of any SAF feedstock, often exceeding 90% reduction versus fossil jet fuel, making it highly valuable for airline sustainability obligations.
application: Advanced SAF feedstock (HEFA and bio-methane-to-jet pathways); RED II Annex IX double-counting; CORSIA eligible for highest-tier GHG credits.
packing: Bulk liquid (POME oil fraction), biogas in pipeline

name: Tall Oil
info: Tall oil is a byproduct of the Kraft wood pulping process. It is a mixture of rosin acids, fatty acids, and sterols.
description: Crude tall oil (CTO) and its distilled fractions (TOFA – Tall Oil Fatty Acids) are advanced SAF and biofuel feedstocks classified under RED II Annex IX. Tall oil provides among the highest GHG savings of any lignocellulosic feedstock and is widely used in the HEFA-SPK pathway for sustainable aviation fuel production.
application: Premium advanced SAF feedstock via HEFA pathway; RED II Annex IX double-counting; also used as feedstock for HVO renewable diesel and specialty chemicals (rosin derivatives, dimer acids).
specification: Tall Oil Fatty Acids (TOFA): FFA content: min 90%
Appearance: amber to dark brown liquid

name: Butter
info: Unsalted butter is a concentrated dairy fat made from 100% pasteurized natural cream, with a minimum fat content of 82.5%.
description: This premium unsalted butter is characterized by its homogenous, plastic consistency and pure, well-defined creamy flavor from pasteurization. Produced under DSTU 4399:2005 standards, it delivers a dense, digestible energy source rich in fat-soluble nutrients for premium bakery, confectionery, and specialty food applications.
application: Flavor enhancer for bakery and confectionery; high-calorie nutritional base for premium food products.
packing: 25 kg carton case net with polyethylene packet
